title: An even-subset sum for Pell numbers
summary: Choose an even number of cells from a row and pair them in order. Color each pair in one of two ways. The total is the sum of two consecutive Pell numbers.

tasks.title: Count even subsets by recurrence
tasks.claim: ∀ n : ℕ, evenSubsetCount (n + 2) = 2 * evenSubsetCount (n + 1) + evenSubsetCount n
tasks.role: Gives the recurrence for the weighted binomial counts.
tasks.context: The even and odd coefficient sums A(n), B(n) of (1+x)^n with x²=2 satisfy A(n+1)=A(n)+2B(n) and B(n+1)=A(n)+B(n). Eliminate B to get A(n+2)=2A(n+1)+A(n). For the source's bijection, consecutive chosen endpoints bound intervals. Fill each interval with black squares and a final white square or domino, and fill gaps with white squares.

tasks.title: Add adjacent Pell terms
tasks.claim:
∀ n : ℕ, pell (n + 2) + pell (n + 3) =
    2 * (pell (n + 1) + pell (n + 2)) + (pell n + pell (n + 1))
tasks.role: Shows that the right side has the same recurrence.
tasks.context: Expand P(n+3) and P(n+2) using the Pell recurrence and rearrange. In the source, the last tile is either a white square or a domino, giving the two summands.
